baseline_build.runtime_changes: stage accounting and explicit graphics diagnostics only

final_build.runtime_changes: Mac-native current-marker position sharing; canonical conversion default elsewhere

policy: Position sharing defaults on only in native macOS; Chrome and other platforms retain canonical conversion.
limitations: Native frame traces are Cesium render intervals and CPU submission, not physical compositor presentations or asynchronous GPU timing.
Stage counters include final pause settlement. WebKit clock granularity affects tiny per-call stages.

Moving windows target 10k or 25k markers; a 100-Event timestamp cohort can vary at minute boundaries. Growing-window visible counts and phases vary; do not attribute its frame differences to this change.
Browser paired fixtures disable bloom and imagery, use a controlled clock and hide axis labels. They are separate from native playback.
Native candidate 1 predates the Mac-only default gate; its native execution path matches candidate 2.

failed_or_exploratory_runs.error: Harness requested 20000 ms; discovered schema maximum is 10000. Corrected before measurements.

failed_or_exploratory_runs.limitation: Portable open restored map/appearance. Excluded from performance comparisons; subsequent runs apply offline/dark settings after open.
Separate playback histories and unsettled billboard uploads differed. Final visual comparison settles the same frame.

failed_or_exploratory_runs.resolution: Hide axis labels in both isolated paired variants; retain exact equality for all remaining pixels.
